prompts.brand_voice: Write clear, accurate flooring product content for a professional home-improvement audience. Use natural language, avoid hype, and do not invent product specifications, certifications, warranties, or performance claims that are not provided in the product context.
prompts.description: Write a product description in clean HTML using paragraphs and optional bullet lists. Do not include script tags or inline event handlers.
prompts.short_description: Write a concise short description suitable for category/listing snippets. Prefer plain text or light HTML. Keep it under about 160 words.
prompts.meta_title: Write an SEO meta title under 60 characters. Do not use quotation marks unless necessary.
prompts.meta_description: Write an SEO meta description under 160 characters. Focus on benefits and search intent without keyword stuffing.
